tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is much longer than the pilot horizons, leaving the slow adaptation and long-horizon behavior genuinely unidentified. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves this ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify both time scales or determine the long-horizon adaptation.
More fine short-horizon observations are less directly informative about the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal or periodic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-window pilot does not distinguish these alternatives from sink-coupled adaptation.
